[1] It was dictated by Adolf Hitler to his secretary Traudl Junge in his Berlin "Führerbunker" on 29 April 1945, the day he and Eva Braun married.
[2] Eva Anna Paula Hitler ("née" Braun; 6 February 1912 – 30 April 1945) was the longtime companion of Adolf Hitler and, for fewer than 40 hours, his wife.
[3] Adolf Hitler killed himself by gunshot on 30 April 1945 in his "Führerbunker" in Berlin.
